tender.title: Maryhill Housing Association - Heating Maintenance 2026 - 2031

classification.description: Repair and maintenance services of central heating

tender.description:
Maryhill Housing Association (MHA) seeks to appoint a qualified and experienced contractor to deliver a programme of:
Gas servicing + reactive repairs
Boiler Replacements
ASHP servicing and reactive repairs
HHR upgrades
to properties within the Maryhill area of Glasgow, including providing a 24-hour call out service to attend to emergency and urgent reactive repairs.

lots.title: Gas Servicing & Reactive Repairs
lots.description: Gas servicing including routine maintenance and reactive repairs, providing a 24-hour call out service to attend to emergency and urgent reactive repairs.

renewal.description: The buyer may, entirely at their discretion, extend the contract by two further periods of one year.

lots.title: Boiler Replacements
lots.description: A programme of boiler replacements to selected properties within MHA stock.

renewal.description: The buyer may, entirely at their discretion, extend the contract by two further periods of one year.

lots.title: ASHP Installations & Reactive Repairs and HHR Upgrades
lots.description:
Deliver a programme of ASHP servicing including routine maintenance and reactive repairs, plus a 24-hour emergency call out service.
Carry out a separate programme of HHR upgrades to selected properties within MHA stock.

renewal.description: The buyer may, entirely at their discretion, extend the contract by two further periods of one year.
